consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on ML-3201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMBANKMENT_SURVEILLANCE: the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation on ML-3201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically inspecting embankments and instrumentation. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during shift handover while the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 9 April 2022 a corrective action on ML-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
